breadcrumb.label: The Office of the Royal Society holds a ceremony to offer blessings to His Majesty the King, together with volunteer public service and charitable activities in honor of His Majesty the King, on the occasion of His Majesty's Birthday, 28 July 2026

paragraphs: On Wednesday, 15 July 2026 at 10:00 a.m., Professor Emeritus Dr. Suraphon Itsarakraisin, M.D., President of the Royal Society of Thailand, led executives, civil servants and staff of the Office of the Royal Society in a ceremony to offer blessings to His Majesty the King on the occasion of His Majesty's Birthday, 28 July 2026, unveiling the floral, incense and candle offerings, delivering words of blessing and signing birthday blessings before the portrait of His Majesty the King at the 2nd-floor hall of the Office of the Royal Society, The Government Complex Commemorating His Majesty the King's 80th Birthday Anniversary, 5th December B.E. 2550

Then, at 1:50 p.m., Dr. Supharoek Phuphongsak, Secretary-General of the Royal Society, led executives and staff to carry out volunteer public service and charitable activities in honor of His Majesty the King on the occasion of His Majesty's Birthday, 28 July 2026, donating books to the “Chaloem Ratchakumari” Public Library, Khlong Sam Wa District, Bangkok. They were welcomed by Mr. Pricha Phonchomphu, Director of the Don Mueang District Learning Promotion Center, Acting Director of the Khlong Sam Wa District Learning Promotion Center, and his team.
